learning_outcomes.text: Be able to solve problems associated with the use and programming of computers.
Be able to autonomously design structured programs with application in engineering.
Be able to use some useful application in engineering.
Be able to explain the relationships present in a database.
Be able to relate the functions of the operating system to the operation of computers.
Be able to design structured programs with application in engineering.
Be able to describe the structure of a computer.

teaching_methods: Lectures for presenting fundamental concepts and procedures, as well as solving exercises and problems.
Practical application, without using the computer, of concepts and procedures introduced, focused on solving exercises and problems from bulletins.
Practical application through laboratory work, using the computer, of concepts and procedures covered, focused on solving exercises and problems.
Personal study including searching for information beyond that presented in face-to-face classes, through bibliographic searches and other information sources.
